# Test fixtures (owner: W10)

| File | Committed? | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `make-fixture.mjs` | yes | Dependency-free generator for the synthetic fake-camera clip and its schedule. |
| `hands.schedule.json` | yes (28 kB) | Expected hand tips / face anchors every 0.5 s in normalized display space. Drives `tests/e2e/helpers/mockTracking.ts` and the e2e assertions. |
| `hands.y4m` | **no** (≈125 MB, gitignored) | 640×360 @ 30 fps, 12 s, I420. Generated by `npm run fixture` (also automatically by `pretest:e2e`). Fed to Chromium via `--use-file-for-fake-video-capture`. |

Everything is procedural: a grey background, an ellipse "head" with two dark eyes and a mouth, a torso block,
and two L-shaped "hands" (palm disc + index bar up + thumb bar inward). No real footage or third-party media.

Schedule (seconds): 0–2 together · 2–8 apart in an L pose with the screen-left hand higher · 8–10 together · 10–12 apart, same height, wide.

Coordinates are in display space (already mirrored, origin top-left). The clip itself is the camera image,
so shapes are drawn at camera `x = 1 − displayX`.

Regenerate: `node tests/fixtures/make-fixture.mjs` (`--frames N` for a short clip, `--schedule-only` to skip the video).
